verdict.rationale: Gide has a dedicated Data Protection practice page. It says the firm helps clients implement personal data processing and comply with the GDPR and the French Data Protection Act of 1978, including in CNIL sanctions proceedings. A separate IT, Digital & Cybersecurity practice page also exists. Missing for 10: independent corroboration or rankings for the privacy practice, concrete detail on cybersecurity advisory beyond the practice name, and evidence of coverage of non-EU regimes such as CCPA or DPDP.
